sections.title: Hi-Gloss Polyethylene
sections.description: AutoPlate’s Hi-Gloss Polyethylene License Plates feature Digital 4 Color Process imprint and Screened Hi-Gloss Clear Coat for the look of a Full Color glossy photo. Plate size is 6" x 12".

sections.title: Hi-Gloss Aluminum
sections.description: .024" White or Natural Aluminum with Digital 4 Color Process imprint and Screened Hi-Gloss Clear Coat for the look of a Full Color glossy photo. Plate size is 6" x 12".
